title: Aborymon, the Enochian angel in John Dee's Sigillum

tellings.quote: uh an In Nokian angel uh recently discovered in the sigil sigilum de ament.

plain: The researcher Matthew Brown says an angel named Aborymon was "recently discovered" in the Sigillum Dei Aemeth. That is a magical seal diagram linked to John Dee, a scholar and occultist at the court of Elizabeth I. Brown calls Aborymon an Enochian angel, meaning one from the angel language and spirit lore Dee recorded, and he gives no source for the find.
